note: Clark County campground in the Clark County Forest, built around its horse and ATV trails: picket lines and manure bunkers sit among the sites, with a horse challenge area and an ATV/horse trail leaving from the campground. Sites 22-27 have no electric. --Claude
summary: Clark County page, map, 2026 fee table, off-season page, policies and extended-stay PDFs read: 27 sites (22-27 non-electric), vault toilets, water, dump; $24/$30 + $3 weekends, $10 res fee; off-season $20/$26 self-registration; 2-night reservation minimum, 3 days out, 28-night cap. HORSE + OHV drop-candidate flags. Not waterfront; pin fine. Google 4.4 (33).
flags: CRITERIA (HORSE, drop candidate): horse facilities are mixed through the one campground loop with no separate horse area - the map puts picket lines beside sites 3, 4, 9, 11, 12, 18 and 22 and a manure bunker by site 14, plus a loading ramp and a Horse Challenge Area; the county page: 'Picket lines and manure bunkers are available for use within the campground' and 'more than 40 miles of horseback trail'. Google names it 'Wild Rock County Park, Campground & Horseback Trails'. The old note called it 'Horse-oriented ... but a general drive-in campground'. Reviewer decides.

CRITERIA (OHV, drop candidate): the county markets it as an ATV base - 'Campground expansions and improvements are focused on establishing Wild Rock as common destination for ATV and horseback trail pursuits'; 'Centrally located within the Clark County ATV trail system, Wild Rock is fast becoming a key destination for many ATV enthusiasts'; map: 'ATV Camping Welcome on All Sites' with an ATV/Horse Trail starting at the campground. Reads as an ATV/horse trailhead campground rather than a general campground with an OHV side. Reviewer decides.

HOOKUPS: stored water true (note prose) left - the county page says 'electric and water service to many sites', but the 2026 fee table prices Wild Rock only as NON-Electric / Electric (other Clark parks list an 'Electric & Water' class) and the map shows only scattered water spigots; water at sites is doubtful - the two official pages disagree, so not changed. Electric amperage not stated (left unset).
PRICE: local - no gate. $24 non-electric / $30 electric (2026), +$3 Fri-Sat and holiday nights, $10 reservation fee; off-season $20 / $26 self-registration. Google Maps 4.4 (33).
LONG-STAY: not seasonal-lease - reservations cap at 28 nights here (Extended Stay policy 4.2); nightly is the norm.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT - forest clearing along Bald Peak Ave, no water in the 600 m imagery frame or on the map.
PIN: stored 44.6794,-90.8008 is the campground's parking lot at the north end of the site lane (sites run ~50-250 m south) - keep.
